subject.title: test(durable): prove restart and upgrade safety

question: Should this PR continue as PR3 of the durable runtime stack after it is rebased onto the current PR2 head, or should it pause until PR1/PR2 are accepted and merged?
rationale: The idea depends on a maintainer-approved durable-core direction and on a final stacked base; automation cannot choose whether OpenClaw should accept this core runtime surface or a stale stacked branch.

options.title: Require Current PR2 Base And Proof
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto the current PR2 durable-core head, keep the repaired contracts, and add exact-head live restart/upgrade proof before further merge review.

options.title: Pause Until PR1/PR2 Land
options.body: Keep this PR open but stop review promotion until the RFC and durable-core implementation are canonical in the base repository.

options.title: Accept Experimental Stack Risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally review this as an experimental stacked branch despite dirty merge state and stale-base risk.

recommendation.title: Require Current PR2 Base And Proof
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto the current PR2 durable-core head, keep the repaired contracts, and add exact-head live restart/upgrade proof before further merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is a repository-level durable-core product and architecture choice, and CONTRIBUTING.md names steipete as the final product-direction owner.
